description: List all of a page's descendants of a given content type (e.g. "comment", "attachment" — see list_page_descendants for which types exist under a given page). Confirmed live: type="page" 500s server-side on this Confluence version even though it's a documented example type elsewhere in Atlassian's API docs — a real server-side limitation, not specific to this tool.
name: list_page_descendants_of_type
